decisions.reason: Weekly reassessment of GitHub Actions Agentic Workflows (not session SDK Dynamic Workflows). The 2026-02-13 changelog still states technical preview. No newer lifecycle source was fetched. Sources now include safe-outputs docs, but no tenant policy or audit evidence. All gates stay unknown; human dates are not renewed.

citations.quote: The feature is available in technical preview through the gh aw CLI extension.
The supported agent-job path defaults to read-only GitHub access and sandboxed execution.
Safe outputs separate action requests from execution: the agent requests actions through structured output, and separate permission-controlled jobs execute permitted requests.

findings.reason: The changelog names technical preview via the gh aw extension. Plan eligibility, tested client versions and a pilot cohort are not in the fetched evidence.
findings.next: Confirm stage, plan eligibility and a named pilot cohort in current official docs.

findings.reason: No enterprise policy or negative enforcement test is in the fetched evidence.
findings.next: Test whether admins can disable or restrict workflows for a test identity.

findings.reason: Read-only agent-job defaults are documented, but they are configurable. Token scopes, credential owner and revocation are not verified.
findings.next: Document the credential owner and test an out-of-scope access attempt.

findings.reason: No retention, residency or deletion evidence for model inputs and persisted context was fetched.
findings.next: Complete a data-flow review with synthetic data for each engine.

findings.reason: Safe outputs separate requests from writes. Approval boundaries, stop mechanism and a prompt-injection test are not evidenced.
findings.next: Run an untrusted-instruction test and record the stop mechanism.

findings.reason: The safe-outputs page mentions auditability as a goal. No sample trace, log retention or incident reconstruction was fetched.
findings.next: Reconstruct a synthetic run from Actions logs and record gaps.

findings.reason: The billing page was fetched, but it does not state how agentic workflow runs are billed. No budget or measured usage exists.
findings.next: Find the official billing reference for engine and Actions usage, then measure a rehearsal.

findings.reason: Sandboxed execution is described. No endpoint allowlist or denied-destination test on the target runner was fetched.
findings.next: Validate allowed paths and a denied destination on the actual runner.

findings.reason: Technical preview limits, support route and version-change policy are not evidenced. No newer lifecycle source was fetched.
findings.next: Record preview risk acceptance, version inventory and an incident owner.

findings.reason: No fetched evidence covers removing workflows, revoking credentials or cleaning up produced drafts and logs.
findings.next: Write and rehearse a scoped disable and cleanup checklist.
